The generated R4 history contains both contexts; the frozen release3 history remains Observation-only and is not a current-build correction target.
additional_context: Core no longer owns the live extension definition: dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed R5 core extension definitions including observation-bodyPosition. The current FHIR Extension Pack build includes input/definitions/*, and input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-observation-bodyPosition.xml has a Specimen.collection context. Later FHIR-31355/FHIR-26071 work concerns body position as an Observation component and opened unresolved core follow-up FHIR-51528; it does not require a bounded FHIR-17527 edit in core.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because the current authoritative source for this extension is external to core and already includes the requested Specimen.collection context.
